name: Question 3
problem:
A cyclist has a small puncture in one of her tires. The volume of air $V,$ in centimeters cubed, in the tire decreases at a rate that's proportional to the volume at that moment. Every day, the cyclist pumps $10\,{\text{cm}}^{3}$ back into the tire.
What is the differential equation describing the rate of change of the volume of air in the tire  at time $t,$ where $t$ is the time in days?

Question 3
?

A cyclist has a small puncture in one of her tires. The volume of air V, in centimeters cubed, in the tire decreases at a rate that's proportional to the volume at that moment. Every day, the cyclist pumps 10cm3 back into the tire. What is the differential equation describing the rate of change of the volume of air in the tire at time t, where t is the time in days?

a
dVdt=−V−10,k>0
b
dVdt=kV+10,k>0
c
dVdt=−kV−10,k>0
d
dVdt=V−10k,k>0
e
dVdt=−kV+10,k>0
Submit
